description: Since 2019, Democrat Jennifer Gong-Gershowitz has represented this north suburban district, centered in Glenview and including parts of Wilmette, Evanston, Skokie and Northbrook. Gong-Gershowitz, 55, is among the leaders in Springfield on sane gun control legislation, including the state’s ban on assault-style weapons and a 2023 law that allows for lawsuits against gunmakers by victims of gun violence.
